column8: ["The central seat is filled by a teal basin and raised central boss; leave the marked seat empty and open through to the board.","The seat reads as a tilted cup, with a dark far inner wall and a broad near rim; redraw it as concentric shapes seen straight down.","The pale upper-left highlights and dark lower-right shading on the central boss imply directional light; use symmetric tonal bands under even illumination."]
